grammar.label: needn't have done vs didn't need to do
grammar.form: needn't have + past participle; didn't need to + base verb
grammar.meaning: an unnecessary action that was done, against one that was not

explanation.en: 'I needn't have come' means I came and it was unnecessary. 'I didn't need to come' usually means I did not come at all.
explanation.uz: 'I needn't have come' — keldim, lekin shart emas edi. 'I didn't need to come' — odatda umuman kelmadim.

grammar.positive_example: You needn't have waited — the meeting was cancelled.
grammar.negative_example: You didn't need to wait, so you waited two hours.

l1_notes.uz: Ikkala shaklning ma'no farqi o'zbek tilida yo'q; kontekst bilan o'rganiladi.

grammar.label: it's time and would rather + past
grammar.form: It's time we left; I'd rather you didn't
grammar.meaning: a present situation you want changed, expressed with a past form

explanation.en: After 'it's time' and 'would rather + subject' the verb takes a past form although the meaning is present: 'It's time we went.'
explanation.uz: 'it's time' va 'would rather + ega' dan keyin fe'l o'tgan shaklda keladi, garchi ma'no hozirgi bo'lsa ham: 'It's time we went.'

grammar.positive_example: I'd rather you didn't mention it.
grammar.negative_example: I'd rather you don't mention it.

l1_notes.uz: Shakl o'tgan zamon, ma'no hozirgi — bu ikkinchi shartdagi mantiqning takrori.
